title: motionex provider contract (contracts/<name>.json)
description: A contract is the shared shape of one capability (speak lines, list voices). Tools that implement it are its providers: they accept the contract's input fields with the same meaning, may add their own fields, and return a result that matches the contract's output_schema. A job may name the contract instead of a tool and pick the provider with input.provider.

name.description: Dotted contract name, equal to the file name without .json, e.g. voice.speak. It shares the job namespace with tool names, so no tool may have the same name.

outputs.description: The files every provider writes, in words.

input_schema.description: The fields every provider accepts. Must declare a string `provider` property. Providers may add fields, so do not set additionalProperties: false. No defaults: each provider applies its own.

output_schema.description: What every provider's result contains (providers may add fields).
